data.name: Kavika
data.gender_notes: Kavika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess of the Stars and constellations. In Hindu mythology, Kavika is the name of the goddess of stars and constellations. She is also known as Astra-Gauri, the goddess of celestial bodies. Kavika is believed to watch over the night sky and protect her children. The name Kavika carries the meaning “Star Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kavika usually hope their child will grow to embody star goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, guidance, and the connection between the physical world and the cosmos.
data.etymology: Kavika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Star Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kavika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Kavika is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture and mythology, representing the connection between humans and the vast cosmos. Throughout history, Hindu spiritual beliefs have placed great importance on astronomy and astrology. Kavika, as the goddess of stars and constellations, serves as a reminder of this cultural legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, Kavika represents the divine presence and watchful gaze of the goddess among the stars. Her name embodies the deep spiritual connection between the Hindu people and the universe. Kavika is believed to be a guardian of the night sky, offering protection and guidance to her children through the celestial bodies. Therefore, her name is a powerful reminder of the divine cosmic energy that surrounds and protects us all.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kavika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kavi', meaning 'poet' or 'sage'. The name embodies the spiritual quest for knowledge, creativity, and wisdom. It is a reminder to seek the inner poet and sage within, and to express the divine through art and wisdom.
